about.description: EWY is an ETF-tracking perpetual on Paradex referencing iShares MSCI South Korea ETF. Paradex is a permissionless perp and options DEX operating on its own Starknet-based appchain (Paradex Chain / DimeVM), with zero-fee trading, unified cross-margin in USDC, and ZK-encrypted account privacy. The market is cash-settled in USDC.
